completionCriteria: All 16 official district audit lanes plus boundary candidates have an explicit scope and source-attempt record, including failures and no-result communities.

Every candidate in the current agreed source union has a disposition: published canonical location, existing identity/alias, excluded non-local/non-restaurant/outside scope, seasonal/inactive, or held with exact missing evidence.

Published locations have location-specific owner or authoritative evidence, stable IDs, source dates, conservative hours/menu links, correct locality and lifecycle. Different branches survive same-name/domain matches.
Browser, exported catalog, SQLite/report artifacts and discovery filters expose the same accepted locations. No false new-opening flags, fabricated coordinates, ratings, photos or open-now claims.
An initial release can report a bounded verified increase and named remaining gaps. Never claim every regional restaurant is captured from a finite, non-exhaustive directory union.
